 Is there school on Election Day? 
 By Briana Trujillo • 
 Published 48 minutes ago • 
 Updated 42 minutes ago 
 BOOKMARKER 
 The NBC6 South Florida News streaming channel plays local South Florida news 24 hours a day, seven days a week. 
 Public school students in most of South Florida do not have classes on Election Day (Tuesday, Nov. 3). 
 In Miami-Dade, public schools are closed for a Teacher Planning Day. In Broward, public schools are closed for an Employee Planning Day. In Palm Beach, public schools are closed for a Professional Development Day for staff, and district offices will be open. 
 Watch NBC6 free wherever you are
   WATCH HERE 
 Friendly reminder, @MDCPS Family! All M-DCPS schools will be closed tomorrow, November 3, for a Teacher Planning Day and will reopen on Wednesday, November 4. https://t.co/lHHUgR7it8
— Miami-Dade Schools (@MDCPS) November 2, 2026 
 In Monroe, schools are open, and students will have a regular school day. 
 📢 Reminder: Tuesday, November 3, 2026 is an Employee Planning Day. All schools will be closed for students as BCPS staff participate in professional development and planning.
Thank you for your continued partnership. https://t.co/kI693CCd1S
— Broward County Public Schools (@browardschools) November 2, 2026
